newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Taiping rises to new 12-month high.
newsitem.headline: Taiping rises to new 12-month high.

text.p: Shares of retail property developer Taiping Consolidated Bhd rose on Tuesday to a new 12-month high on lingering rumours it was planning to sell some properties, brokers and analysts said.
After the first half hour of trading, Taiping shares were up 14 cents to 3.20 ringgit on rumours it may be selling its entire interest in Sentul Raya, a mixed property development in Kuala Lumpur.
In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) on Monday, the company said it had no knowledge of why the shares were active.
"We are not aware of any reasons for the unusual market movement," Taiping said in a statement in reply to a query from the KLSE on the stock's surge.
On Monday, the stock jumped 88 cents or 40.37 percent to 3.06 ringgit on volume of 32.3 million.
